tracks.title: And A Bang On The Ear

verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 26 that year.

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
, but that version lacks a PRT identifier in the runouts.

Issued with a cardboard inner sleeve with photos and full credits.
Made in England. 
℗ & © 1988 Ensign Records Limited.

Original Recording made by Ensign Records Limited, Ensign is a Division of Chrysalis Records Limited.

Side A: Recorded at Windmill Lane, Dublin, Ireland, Jan - March 1986.
Side B: Recorded at Spiddal House, Spiddal, County Galway, Ireland, April - June 1988.

Publishers:
A1: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music, *Blue Mountain Music
A2: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music
A3: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music †Polygram Music
A4: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music + Copyright Control *The Welk Music Group
A5: Warner Bros. Music
B1, B4: Copyright Control
B2: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music, *Polygram Music
B3: Dizzy Heights Music/Chrysalis Music †Blue Mountain Music
B5: Blue Mountain Music
B6: Chrysalis Music

"This Land is Your Land" written by Woody Guthrie, published by TRO-Essex Music.
"Blackbird" written by Lennon-McCartney, published by Northern Songs.

All elements of the runouts are etched on both sides except for the CBS pressing symbols 'C' and/or 'A' (which may appear as Λ or ∴) and any numbers which are stamped.
